mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (demand) above its 5-month average signals rising corporate activity, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns when GDPC1 exceeds its 5-month average in a non-recessionary context (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% indicates improving labor market conditions, attracting investment and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE falls below 4.0% in a period of rising unemployment (contradiction).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (employment) signal robust economic growth, compressing discount rates and elevating equity valuations for positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window for the GDPC1-HOUST interaction, indicating no significant predictive power.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO > 105) in a late-cycle expansion period reduces inflationary pressures, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO exceeds 105 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 5.5% signals aggressive tightening, creating market uncertainty that temporarily depresses S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX positive returns when FEDFUNDS >5.5% in a high-inflation environment (contradiction).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.5% triggers market volatility as investors anticipate prolonged tightness, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX positive returns within 5 days after FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.5% (contradicts model).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained UNRATE declines below 4.2% reflect improving labor market conditions, attracting capital and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE falls below 4.2% in a non-recessionary context (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in UNRATE and rises in PAYEMS signal strengthening labor market recovery, boosting investor sentiment and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative during improving labor market when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises (contradiction).
